summary: Several studies have directly applied graph neural networks to fraud detection. Fischer et al. (2023) [V0052] used message passing over relational graphs on the GridWatch dataset, achieving an F1 score of 0.8. El-Sayed et al. (2022) [V0051] employed a similar approach on ToxiBench, reporting an AUROC of 0.73. Chen et al. (2020) [V0049] achieved an accuracy of 0.94 on LedgerGuard using message passing over relational graphs. Duarte et al. (2021) [V0050] reported an MAE of 0.66 on CellLife. Additionally, Chen et al. (2019) [V0072] used representation learning with paired positive and negative examples on GridWatch, achieving an accuracy of 0.65.
